title: The announcement
text:
I'm heading to Fresno on Wednesday, Nov. 18, to join Stratton Brown and Deal Champs for their final meetup in Fresno.

Real estate is changing, and AI is opening up new possibilities for how investors find opportunities, evaluate deals and grow their businesses. I'll dig into how AI is changing real estate, where seller opportunities are emerging in today's market, and what successful operators are doing differently to acquire inventory and close deals.

6-8:30 p.m. PT. Register here and you'll get the exact location: https://meet.sundae.com/fresno-nov-2026

title: Meet the speaker
text:
Meet the speaker for Fresno.

Josh Stech, co-founder and CEO of Sundae, has spent his career at the intersection of technology and residential real estate. Before Sundae, Josh was a founding partner at LendingHome and co-founded Purpose Built Investments, launching three funds. Josh is an angel investor in 107 companies.
